author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: "यद्यपि" इति, एते दुर्योधनादयः राज्यलोभेनोपहतचेतसः नष्टधर्मज्ञानाः "दोषम्" "पातकम्" "न" "च" "पश्यन्ति" "यद्यपि", तथाऽपि हे"जनार्दन" जननरहित संसारार्दन,"कुलक्षयकृतं दोषम्" "प्रपश्यद्भिर्" "अस्माभिः" "अस्माद्" दोषान्"निवर्तितुम्" "कथं न ज्ञेयम्"? ॥१.३८-३९॥
translation: Only sin will take hold of us in slaying these, for though they are ruffians, we kill our own kinsmen. So, it is not fit that we kill the sons of Dhritarashtra, our kinsmen. Indeed, how can we be happy, O Madhava, having killed our kith and kin? However, those infatuated with greed do not see the guilt) in the destruction of the race and do not see the sin in being treacherous (to the lives of) friends. Why should not we also) see that it is wise) to turn away from such a sin, O Janardana, we who clearly perceive the evils in the destruction of races? (36-39)
